summary_hint: IRS K-1 transcript, tax year 2024, Form 1120-S — Rivera Holdings LLC (EIN ..2231), shareholder Jordan Rivera 40%, ordinary business income $92,400, distributions $60,000.

typed_core.name: tax_year
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the year the figures belong to; a K-1 income figure is misreadable without its year

typed_core.name: source_form
typed_core.why: identity — 1120-S (S-corp) vs 1065 (partnership); changes how lines map

typed_core.name: entity_ein_masked
typed_core.why: PII (restricted) — business EIN; entity grouping key

typed_core.name: ownership_percentage
typed_core.why: processor — allocation share; proportion of income counted
typed_core.prompt_hint: Profit %, loss %, and capital % may all appear and differ; capture the stated share(s) verbatim, do not pick one silently

typed_core.name: guaranteed_payments_or_compensation
typed_core.why: processor — partner compensation (1065) counts toward income

typed_core.name: distributions_or_withdrawals
typed_core.why: processor — cash actually taken; liquidity/support for income

nested_lists.name: transcript_line_items
nested_lists.shape_reason: an IRS transcript enumerates many coded lines (line_code, description, amount); flat rows are the light shape and stay under the ceiling. Serves pass-through income reconciliation — the natural single nested list for the document

fields.name: line_code
fields.why: the transcript line reference to map to a K-1 box meaning

fields.name: amount
fields.why: the line amount; preserve sign for losses

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date, document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: classification/version metadata; source_form is the real form signal

rejected.name: issuer_name, issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: issuer is the IRS; no contact/verification need

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses, property_address
rejected.reason: duplicate entity/shareholder fields; no property link

rejected.name: account_adjustments_or_mismatches
rejected.reason: a judgment/exception list, not a fact — leave to tag/rule layer; catch-all

encoding_variations: tax_year — '2024', 'TAX PERIOD DEC. 31, 2024', '202412'; IRS transcripts encode the period as a YYYYMM cycle — normalize but keep the raw beside the income
source_form — 'FORM 1120S', '1065', 'SCH K-1'; the form governs whether 'ordinary business income' is Box 1 of an 1120-S K-1 or a 1065 K-1 with guaranteed payments — carry the form
ownership_percentage — profit %, loss %, and capital % may all appear and differ; capture the stated share(s) verbatim, do not pick one silently
Losses appear in parentheses or with a trailing minus — preserve sign

open_questions.q: ownership_percentage flattening — profit/loss/capital shares can differ
options: split into typed fields per share
open_questions.recommendation: capture the stated share(s) as a single string with the label; split into typed fields only if a rule must apply the profit % specifically

open_questions.q: interest_dividends_and_gains flattening — flattened to one string
options: break out interest_income, dividend_income, capital_gain as Decimals
open_questions.recommendation: keep one string; break out the components only if a rule needs them

open_questions.q: Line-item vs summary duplication — several summary lines (ordinary income, guaranteed payments) also appear inside transcript_line_items
open_questions.recommendation: keep both — the typed summary fields are the stable rule targets; the list is the audit trail

notes: No rules consume this type today, so there is no rule floor. This is an IRS-sourced pass-through income record; fields are chosen for future self-employment / pass-through income qualification — the year, the entity, the ownership %, and the income lines — plus the EIN/TIN PII.

PII: entity_ein_masked (restricted, pre-masked) — registry has employer_ein but this field's name differs, needs _PII_FIELDS registration under its own name, pre_masked true. shareholder_or_partner_tin_masked (highly_restricted, pre-masked) — registry has taxpayer_ssn_masked / recipient_tin but this name differs, needs registration, pre_masked true.

Prompt hint (doc-level): IRS transcripts label figures by line reference, often abbreviated/truncated; map to the K-1 box meaning (1120-S K-1 Box 1 = ordinary business income; 1065 K-1 Box 1 = ordinary business income, Box 4 = guaranteed payments, Box 19 = distributions).

Prompt hint (doc-level): A transcript reflects what the IRS has on file (may lag the return); transcript_request_or_run_date and tax_year together tell a processor how current it is. EIN/TIN arrive pre-masked (e.g. XX-XXX2231, XXX-XX-4487) — keep them masked; never reconstruct.
Ambiguity: ordinary_business_income_or_loss is tagged 'headline' (not a defined reason_class); classified as processor (the primary qualifying-income figure).
